verdict.rationale: Skyvern's product page directly claims the story's capability: it caches generated Playwright code after the first run, and repeat runs skip the LLM entirely. It claims this is 3–5× faster, up to 70% cheaper, and fully deterministic. That covers caching, deterministic replay, and lower cost and latency, but the support is one marketing-page line rather than in-depth developer documentation. missing for 10: developer docs on how caching works (cache scope, invalidation or fallback when the page changes, SDK/API controls) and independent or hands-on corroboration of the speed and cost claims.
